variants.A: Game title logo for an original anti-gravity arcade racing game: the single word HYPERLANE in huge bold italic futuristic letters, chrome steel with a bright cyan neon edge glow and a magenta underglow, motion speed streaks trailing to the left, a thin glowing horizon line under it. Exactly the word HYPERLANE, spelled H-Y-P-E-R-L-A-N-E, nothing else written. Centered on a pure black background, no other objects, 1990s console racing game title screen remade in modern quality.
variants.B: Game title logo: the word HYPERLANE in wide heavy italic letters with sharp angular cuts, gradient from white-hot to electric cyan, glowing magenta outline, a chevron arrow integrated into the letter A, speed lines. Exactly the word HYPERLANE, spelled H-Y-P-E-R-L-A-N-E, no other text. Centered on a pure black background, nothing else in the image, retro-futuristic arcade racing title.
